texts.zh:
近期，一个处于[awakened_horde.GetName]控制下的太空居所被摧毁，这直接导致[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]历史上破天荒地团结在一位大可汗的统治之下。这位神秘的军阀以超群之才，据传是一位力量强大的灵媒，说服了[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]各族搁置争议，谋求生存。

庞大的战舰从先前隐藏的锚地中徐徐驶出，载满了[From.GetSpeciesName]的狂热战士。在大可汗的领导与鼓舞之下，他们将替死去的同胞向这片星海发起绝罚。
texts.en:
The recent destruction of one of their large void dwellings at the hands of the [awakened_horde.GetName] has prompted the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to unite under a single Great Khan for the first time in history. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has convinced the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to put aside their differences for the sake of continued survival.

Great war fleets from previously hidden anchorages are being crewed by eager [From.GetSpeciesName] warriors and restored into working order. Under the inspired leadership of their Great Khan, they now demand vengeance from the galaxy for their lost kin.
